raw.description: Crawl internal pages and aggregate accessibility violations across the site.

browserSessionId.description: Browser session to run this tool in, as returned by browser_session_open. Omit to use the default session.

disableRules.description: Axe rule ids to skip, e.g. ["color-contrast"]. Unlike withRules this narrows whatever is already selected, so it applies to violationsTag and withRules alike. Disabling every rule in withRules is an error, not an empty scan. Unknown rule ids are rejected rather than silently skipped.

excludePathPatterns.description: Regex patterns applied to pathname+query. Avoid complex nested quantifiers to prevent performance issues.

excludeSelectors.description: CSS selectors to exclude from the scan, e.g. ["#cookie-banner", "iframe.chat-widget"]. Applied after includeSelectors, so it can carve regions out of an included subtree.

ignoreQueryParams.description: Query parameters dropped during URL normalization.

includeIncomplete.description: Also collect Axe "incomplete" results — checks Axe could not decide automatically. They are reported separately from violations.

includeSelectors.description: CSS selectors to restrict the scan to, e.g. ["#checkout-form"]. Omit to scan the whole page. Each selector may match multiple elements.

includeSubdomains.description: Only applies when sameOriginOnly=true. When enabled, also allows subdomains of the start host (e.g. blog.example.com when start host is example.com). Ignored when sameOriginOnly=false.

maxDepth.description: Maximum crawl depth for link strategy.

maxNodesPerViolation.description: Maximum nodes kept per violation in the report.

sameOriginOnly.description: Restrict crawl to the start origin/host.

sitemapUrl.description: URL of the sitemap to fetch when strategy is "sitemap".

startUrl.description: URL to start the crawl from. Defaults to the current tab URL.

strategy.description: How to discover pages to scan.

urls.description: Explicit URL list when strategy is "provided".

violationsTag.description: Axe tags to include in scans.

waitAfterNavigationMs.description: Extra wait after navigation before scanning.

withRules.description: Run only these Axe rule ids, e.g. ["color-contrast", "image-alt"]. Axe can run a rule list or a tag list but never both, so setting withRules ignores violationsTag entirely. Unknown rule ids are rejected rather than silently skipped, and so is an empty list — omit the option to scan by tags instead.

raw.description: Scan the current page for accessibility violations using Axe

annotateScreenshot.description: Capture a full-page PNG with every violating element outlined and labelled with its rule ids, then remove the markers. Off by default because screenshots are expensive. At most 50 elements are marked; nodes that are hidden, zero-size, off-canvas, or inside an iframe cannot be marked and are reported as skipped.

browserSessionId.description: Browser session to run this tool in, as returned by browser_session_open. Omit to use the default session.

disableRules.description: Axe rule ids to skip, e.g. ["color-contrast"]. Unlike withRules this narrows whatever is already selected, so it applies to violationsTag and withRules alike. Disabling every rule in withRules is an error, not an empty scan. Unknown rule ids are rejected rather than silently skipped.

excludeSelectors.description: CSS selectors to exclude from the scan, e.g. ["#cookie-banner", "iframe.chat-widget"]. Applied after includeSelectors, so it can carve regions out of an included subtree.

includeIncomplete.description: Include Axe "incomplete" results — checks Axe could not decide automatically (e.g. contrast over an image). Inspect the page yourself to resolve them.

includeSelectors.description: CSS selectors to restrict the scan to, e.g. ["#checkout-form"]. Omit to scan the whole page. Each selector may match multiple elements.

maxNodesPerViolation.description: Maximum nodes reported per rule. Raise it when you need every occurrence of a rule rather than a sample.

violationsTag.description: Axe tags to scan for. Defaults to the WCAG and Section 508 conformance tags, so a default report means "this fails a conformance criterion". The category tags ("cat.*") and "best-practice" also select rules that are not conformance failures, so they must be requested explicitly.

withRules.description: Run only these Axe rule ids, e.g. ["color-contrast", "image-alt"]. Axe can run a rule list or a tag list but never both, so setting withRules ignores violationsTag entirely. Unknown rule ids are rejected rather than silently skipped, and so is an empty list — omit the option to scan by tags instead.
